text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's racing racewear has 
finally arrived.

She told me, 'The design is a surprise 
until it arrives!' So this is the very 
first time I'm seeing it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-chan! Isn't it super 
wonderful~♪
choice_data_list: I was sure it'd be way more frilly...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Maya was troubled over that too, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I thought something like this would look 
sexy and suit me! What do you think?
choice_data_list: I think looking cool is a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's mom and dad praised my outfit 
sketches too~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You look so cool, just like Dad when he 
was young!" she said!
choice_data_list: What does your father do for work...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! A pilot soaring across the vast sky☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, Maya got to ride in a 
small jet that Papa was flying~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The sky was super wide, and Maya and 
everyone's town was so tiny and far away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya used to love zooming all around the 
wide open view~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Flying through the sky is just like 
racing! It's so thrilling and 
heart-pounding!♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why my racewear's designed like 
this too☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like running freely in the fun, open sky, 
I'm gonna dash around the course~!
choice_data_list: Time to take off into all kinds of races!
Time to take off into all kinds of races!
Now I understand what drives Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like running freely in the fun, open sky, 
I'm gonna dash around the course~!
choice_data_list: Time to take off into all kinds of races!
Time to take off into all kinds of races!
Now I understand what drives Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
On Maya's flight, I'll show the whole 
audience a wonderful view, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You be careful not to miss the train too, 
Trainer-chan!"
choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna get waaaay faster from here on 
out, so keep your eyes glued to Maya, 
okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ It's a promise between the two of 
us, okay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okay smile☆ Lucky peace sign! Mayano Top 
Gun, taking off~~~~~♪

Putting on her racing silks seems to have 
boosted Mayano Top Gun's desire for 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really, really?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, you're becoming more and 
more of an expert on Maya, aren't you~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you'll eventually understand Maya 
even better than Mom and Dad... Eek~☆
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, did you show your 
outfit to your parents?

Come to think of it, did you show your 
outfit to your parents?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, not yet!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I decided a long time ago that 
Trainer-chan would be the first one I'd 
show♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! I'll send some pictures to 
Mommy and Daddy!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's take one together too, Trainer-chan! 
Come on, please?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "All of that is— all clear, green to go!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Both Papa and Mama said they're super 
curious about you, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get closer~! Ready, set... take 
oook☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that turned out perfectly♪ And... 
sent!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! A message from my parents! Let's 
see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♪ They said Trainer-chan seems like a 
really wonderful person!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"They said, ‘Please take good care of Maya 
too’! Guess you're officially 
parent-approved now☆"

Though a bit ticklish, I reaffirmed my 
resolve to keep supporting her from now 
on.
